required_features: Broad stepped cone, five adult whorls; final bodywhorl broad, not a thin elongated snail tower.
Continuous midwhorl selenizone separate from shoulderkeel; shallowdoubleboundary+medianridge suffices.
Shoulder nodules gently scalloped, not largehorns; fine reticulation may be simplified.
Broad subcircular/subtrapezoidal mouth with small true open outer-lip slit aligned to selenizone. Slit is disclosed interpretation, not crack or painted line.
Closed umbilicus and shallowconvex spiralbase; no giant bottomhole.
Worn incomplete protoconch retained; no artificially lengthened apex.
